title: main.rs startup order: outbox+discovery start before we know if binding succeeds
description: main.rs starts the outbox worker and discovery task before attempting tailnet binding (lines 211-238 vs 253). If binding fails and the fallback KITHD_BIND_ADDR is also unset, the process exits at line 383 — but outbox and discovery tasks are already spawned and still running in the background during the exit path. They are orphaned until the process exits, which tokio handles. No data corruption, but the startup sequence is non-obvious. A comment above step 11 explaining 'These tasks are spawned before binding; if binding fails and the process exits, tokio drops them cleanly' would help future contributors.
